extraction.text:
Victor Gnanaraj

Dubai / Abu Dhabi, UAE | 9910401408 | victorgnanaraj_msc@yahoo.co.in

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/victor-gnanaraj-147b5622/

SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST – BANKING OPERATIONS & TRANSFORMATION

Senior Business Analyst with 15+ years of international experience across capital markets, wealth management, post-trade operations, and banking transformation within global financial institutions including Saxo Bank, ADCB, and Lunate Capital.

Strong domain expertise across front-to-back trade lifecycle management, settlements, reconciliation, corporate actions, regulatory reporting, and operational process optimization covering Equities, FX, Bonds, CFDs, Futures, Options, Derivatives, Mutual Funds, and Pension/Tax-advantaged investment accounts.

Demonstrated success in driving operational transformation initiatives, automating low-value manual processes, improving STP rates, coordinating cross-functional banking technology programs, and translating complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Banking Operations & Back Office Transformation

Capital Markets & Post-Trade Processing

Trade Lifecycle Management

Settlements, Netting & Reconciliation

Corporate Actions Processing

SWIFT Settlement Messaging

Wealth Management Operations

Business Process Re-engineering (AS-IS / TO-BE)

Business Requirements & Functional Analysis

UAT, SIT & Test Strategy Coordination

Agile / Scrum Delivery

Process Automation & STP Optimization

Regulatory & Tax Reporting

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Lunate | Senior Business Analyst | UAE | Oct 2025 – Present

Lead end-to-end business analysis and delivery initiatives across Private Equity, Asset Management, and Investment Operations platforms.

Drive strategic transformation programs spanning Dynamo, Investran, Salesforce, enterprise data platforms, and operational workflows.

Design and coordinate API and MFT-based integrations between front-office investment platforms and fund accounting ecosystems.

Manage complete SDLC delivery lifecycle including requirements gathering, BRDs/FRDs, solution workshops, SIT/UAT coordination, defect management, and production rollout.

Led end-to-end Business Analysis for Asset Management and Investment Operations platforms, covering requirements gathering, BRDs/FRDs, solution workshops, SIT/UAT, defect management and production rollout.

Worked on client onboarding and lifecycle transformation, including onboarding process optimization that reduced onboarding turnaround time by 39% through automation and workflow improvements.

Designed API and MFT-based integrations between front-office investment platforms and fund-accounting ecosystems, supporting seamless client/investment data flow.

Worked across the investment lifecycle, including front-office, middle-office and back-office processes, settlements, reconciliation, corporate actions and investment operations.

Partnered with global stakeholders, custodians, counterparties and technology teams to translate business requirements into functional solutions and support implementation, testing and production readiness.

ADCB | Senior Business Analyst | UAE | Nov 2024 – Apr 2025

Managed corporate and digital card onboarding solutions across credit/debit verticals.

Implemented Touchpoint redemption, Currency conversion fee.

Defined backlog roadmap coordinated Scrum ceremonies, and optimized UAT/test coverage.

Requirement Analysis and producing high quality and concise requirements and design documents including Business Requirement Documents, Technical Specification Documents, Visio Flows, Business Cases.

Supported end-to-end client lifecycle processes across Asset Management and Investment Operations, covering client onboarding, account setup, investment-platform workflows and downstream operational readiness.

Worked with business, technology, custodians and counterparties to streamline client lifecycle journeys, identifying process gaps, defining functional requirements and implementing automation/integration solutions to improve onboarding and operational efficiency.

Saxo Bank | Business Analyst – Capital Markets & Banking Operations | Denmark | 2011 – 2023

Managed and supported end-to-end post-trade processing activities across Equities, FX, Bonds, CFDs, Futures, Options, Derivatives, Mutual Funds, and Pension/Tax-saving investment accounts.

Worked extensively on settlement processing across executing brokers and settlement brokers including resetting, netting, averaging, settlement matching, and trade lifecycle management.

Coordinated with global custodians and counterparties including Citi, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, Barclays, and HSBC across international exchanges.

Supported settlement operations utilizing SWIFT settlement messaging standards.

Managed voluntary and mandatory corporate actions processing across global markets.

Led operational transformation and process optimization initiatives focused on increasing automation and improving STP efficiency.

Gathered business requirements and produced BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.

Coordinated SIT and UAT activities including test planning, execution management, and production readiness validation.

Worked across Saxo Trading Platform, Bloomberg, Enfusion, Investran, JIRA, Power BI, Oracle PL/SQL, and MS SQL.

Delivered 10+ transformation initiatives using Agile methodologies.

Reduced onboarding turnaround time by 39% and achieved annual operational savings exceeding DKK 300,000 through automation and workflow optimization initiatives.

TECHNICAL & BANKING SKILLS

Capital Markets Operations

Wealth Management

Brokerage Operations

Settlement & Reconciliation

Corporate Actions

SWIFT Messaging

Front, Middle & Back Office Operations

BRD / FRD Documentation

Agile Scrum Delivery

UAT / SIT Coordination

Process Mapping

Stakeholder Workshops

Saxo Trading Platform

Bloomberg

Enfusion

Investran

Salesforce

JIRA / Confluence

Power BI

Oracle PL/SQL

MS SQL

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)

PRINCE2 Foundation Certification

ISTQB Certified Associate in Software Testing

EDUCATION

MSc Computer Science – Bharathidasan University (2001 – 2003) BSc Electronics – Bharathiar University (1998 – 2001)
